_README: WHAT PLAYS WHEN. Hand-written; the exporter never touches this file, the
same as rules.json, modifier_effects.json and intent_patterns.json.
Nothing here has a sound yet, and that is deliberate: the wiring ships
silent. Every entry below is already connected to the moment it names, so
dropping an .ogg into assets/audio/ and writing its filename against the
right key is the whole job. No code changes.
A key with an empty 'file' is a no-op. A key whose file is not there logs
one quiet line the first time and is never mentioned again, exactly as
ArtLoader does for art that has not been drawn.
THE BUSES. Three, so they can be mixed and muted separately:
music   — the bed under a stage. One at a time, looped.
effects — a card, a gaffe, a turn ending.
speech  — spoken lines. Its own bus so it can duck the music later and
so a player who wants the words without the score can have
SPEECH is keyed by whoever is speaking, not by event, because a line
belongs to a character, and then by line ID. Empty until Cameron records

card_useless.when: a card was played that this room ignores

intent_revealed.when: the opponent's next move becomes known

gaffe_final.when: one more gaffe would end the stage

xp_spent.when: XP was spent in the Office
